command: Populus chloroplast-encoded ATP synthase beta subunit atpB (A4GYR7) is a functional component of the vacuolar membrane or plant-type vacuole. Distinguish an authentic additional localization from V1-A/F1-beta ancestral misplacement, degradative chloroplast cargo, or a mapping artifact. The old GOA cites PTN000389801 and PTN000389877 in PTHR15184. The current PANTHER tree contains the F1-beta node PTN008558586 and confirmed F1-beta homologs but neither this exact Populus accession nor those old node ids; do not infer a reconstructed target lineage from WITH/FROM alone. Current UniProt places A4GYR7 in SF71. Determine whether phylogeny, targeting/assembly, direct localization or subcellular proteomics support or refute these two assertions independently. Predominant thylakoid localization alone is not proof against a secondary pool. Reversible ATP hydrolysis is independently supported by primary chloroplast ATP-synthase studies and is not evidence of vacuolar localization.
